admission.justification: With any one of these obligations missing, an interrupted or refused retirement can leave a sprint naming a master it cannot resolve or a record another writer can change, and repeating the request no longer completes the operation.

guarantee: Every route that completes or retires a master decides the abandoned-row contradiction again from the records on disk, and a master's retirement is one operation whose records no other writer may change: an interrupted retirement is completed by repeating the identical request, and every refusal names the file, the row and the action that clears it.
title: Retirement and abandoned-row truth at every route
